description: This PHP source file defines a class 'EditMyAttendanceRecordMenuConfigurator' that implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. It configures menu settings related to the user's attendance record by overriding the module and screen identifiers in the application's UI.

classes.name: EditMyAttendanceRecordMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class that configures the menu for editing or viewing the user's attendance record by setting appropriate module and screen parameters.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default module and screen for the current user interface context to 'time' and 'viewMyAttendanceRecord' respectively.
